jobs.program: 2027 Summer Clerkship Recruitment Program (clerkships running over the 2027/28 summer)
jobs.notes: Confirmed future window published by the Law Society of NSW: applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027; the scheme has two closing dates (11:59pm AEST Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, varying by cohort/exam timetable), with offers able to be made from 9:00am AEST Wed 8 September 2027 and accepted/declined by 1:00pm AEST Thu 9 September 2027 — applicants must be in their penultimate or final year of law.
